scientific_question: Does the author-provided pET21 5'UTR plus first-48-nt CDS folding feature (Delta G_UH; raw column Gz48v) add protein-cluster-OOD expression prediction value beyond the previously frozen RK07 sequence proxies?
observed_phenomenon: RK22 supported a 5' structure increment in fixed-GFP development data, whereas RK07 did not test the author-provided UTR+head feature and RK20 did not support observed-R1 structure increments in a different GFP library.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Adding Gz48v to the RK07 feature set improves both Spearman and MSE on the existing Boel operational-protein-cluster test split under both a linear multinomial logistic backbone and a fixed HistGradientBoosting backbone.
scientific_scope: Boel 2016 cross-protein, non-synonymous ordinal expression data; protein-cluster OOD transport of an initiation-structure feature. This is not a fixed-protein synonymous-library test, not functional untouched, and not SOTA evidence.

source_feature.definition: Predicted partition-function folding free energy for the pET21 5'UTR plus the first 48 nt of the CDS, as defined by Boel et al.

secondary_descriptive_contrast.name: simple_plus_uh_minus_simple
secondary_descriptive_contrast.inference: descriptive only; excluded from the primary Holm family and gate

logistic.standardization: train mean and population standard deviation; no dev/test fitting
logistic.selection: fixed a priori; no hyperparameter search

histgb.selection: fixed a priori; no hyperparameter search

primary_endpoints.direction: base MSE minus augmented MSE; pass if > 0
base MSE minus augmented MSE; pass if > 0

permutation.procedure: within each resampled cluster, exchange base and augmented prediction vectors with probability 0.5; recompute paired effects
permutation.p_value: two-sided absolute-effect tail with plus-one correction

multiple_testing: Holm across exactly four primary endpoints, separately within each evaluation split; the scientific gate uses only the test family
evaluation_order: freeze protocol, implementation, tests and input hashes before label modelling
fit train only and write train/dev predictions and model artifact
commit and push the frozen protocol and implementation before test evaluation
load frozen train/dev model artifact and require exact dev reproduction
evaluate the existing test split once under this protocol; it is reused and not globally untouched
independently reconstruct features, models, predictions and resampling before reporting

stratification.scope: descriptive test failure regions; no additional inferential gate

gate.reason: Boel is cross-protein and non-synonymous; this experiment alone cannot establish fixed-protein synonymous spatial coupling, velocity/decay mechanisms, external SOTA or generator readiness.

optimized_construct_boundary.numeric_fig5_content: growth curves for RSP_2139 and SRU_1983 only
optimized_construct_boundary.p025_p50_p975_interpretation: model prediction quantiles, not measured expression labels

prohibited_claims: causal isolation of the UTR from folding-algorithm or correlated sequence effects
use of optimized-construct model prediction quantiles as functional ground truth
use of MAGE functional_untouched for fitting, tuning or evaluation
